0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-7, 13th in the East, 1-4 on the road, on a one-game losing streak) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (4-5, 11th in the West, also on a one-game losing streak) in the Nets' 11th game of the season. Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Mikel Brown Jr. (rest; 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes per game this season) are both out for Brooklyn, and no New Orleans players are listed as unavailable. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not yet met in 2026-27, and their last meeting was a 116-113 Brooklyn loss in New Orleans on January 14, 2026.
